answer: Calfskins soak in the parchmenter's trough, limed and soft. island lifts a skin onto the frame and stretches it taut. The rule is pinned to the frame itself: Proof of parchmenter via stretched skin tally — a skin the parchmenter stretches only after 1021 skins stretch true without one tearing at the edge, each stretched by the parchmenter himself. cipher scrapes the flesh side smooth with the crescent knife. anchor chalks the skin and cuts it square. One thousand and twenty-one skins must stretch true without one tearing at the edge, and the next still tears where the lime ran strong.
